title: Elixir of Life Vision
description: A surreal painting shows a woman in a blue sari holding a glowing green bottle labeled 'Elixir of Life' on a starry blue table. Beside her is a line-drawn duplicate of herself with closed eyes, while a crystal ball reveals a cosmic galaxy; the background features a lavender field, geometric shapes, a ringed planet, a red planet, and intricate line-art figures including an alien-like creature and hikers.
prompt: A surreal symbolic artwork featuring a South Asian woman in a rich blue and gold sari with a bindi, gently touching a glowing emerald green potion bottle labeled Elixir of Life that sits on a deep blue starry tablecloth. Next to her is an identical woman rendered in black and white line art with closed eyes. A large crystal ball on the table displays a swirling galaxy with stars and planets. The background transitions from a lavender flower field on the left to a cosmic space scene with geometric sacred shapes, a ringed Saturn-like planet, a large red planet, and intricate line art of an alien figure, hikers with backpacks, and crystal formations. The lower portion shows an upside-down line-drawn face emerging from the table. Dreamlike mystical atmosphere with vibrant colors contrasting black and white elements.
